description: A donut with a legend beneath it that lists every category and its color.
overview: Uses `PieChart` with one `Pie` (`cy="45%"`, `innerRadius="50%"`, `outerRadius="78%"`, `paddingAngle={1}`) and a `ChartLegend` with `verticalAlign="bottom"` rendering `ChartLegendContent` with `nameKey="device"`. `chartData` holds five `{ device, users, fill }` records, where each `fill` is `var(--color-<device>)`. `chartConfig` defines `users` (label only) plus `phone`, `laptop`, `tablet`, `watch` and `other` colored `var(--blue)`, `var(--teal)`, `var(--indigo)`, `var(--orange)` and `var(--gray)`. The tooltip uses `ChartTooltipContent` with `hideLabel` and `nameKey="device"`.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your categories, giving each record a `fill` of `var(--color-<key>)`, and add a matching `chartConfig` entry with `label` and `color` for every key. Keep `dataKey` and `nameKey` on `Pie` pointed at your value and category fields, and update the tooltip's `nameKey` if you rename the category field. The legend resolves labels through `nameKey="device"`, so update it alongside the tooltip if you rename that field. Move `cy` if the legend overlaps the ring at smaller heights.
notes: `accessibilityLayer` is set on `PieChart`, so the chart is focusable and arrow keys move between slices.
